stt.transcript:
បុណ្យ Francophonie?
នៅសួនវត្តបទុម!
Yes! 
កម្មវិធី Francophonie ធ្វើបានល្អខ្លាំង!
យកសិល្បៈចម្លាក់ប្រាសាទនៅក្នុងកម្មវិធីនេះ សុទ្ធតែរូបរាងប្រាសាទបច្ចុប្បន្នភាពជាក់ស្ដែងតែម្ដង!
So if you are nearby this weekend, you must check out Village de la Francophonie.
This event is more than just about French language, it's about bringing different culture together, discovering new experiences, and celebrating the diversity that make our world interesting.
And today we are here as a KOL of Confirel Group.
We are so happy to be the part of this joyful event with you and Confirel.
Confirel is a brand collection of Khmer products and innovative products of every resources you may find in Cambodia.
You can find them at zone 5, booth number B43.
You can try tasting their sample, and you will realize how good the ingredient is.
Because they have a very high-quality packaging, you can easily bring it abroad.
So don't forget to check Francophonie event out, and also don't forget to pay a visit at Confirel booth.
You are watching ម៉ូតូខៀវ.
Live life like local.
See you next episode.
Bye!
